MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 12
   D. 2

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

3. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 16

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

6. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

8. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

9. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

12. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
